istqb.d: The International Software Testing Qualifications Board — the body behind the most widely recognized software-testing certification scheme.
istqb.w: An ISTQB cert is the credential recruiters filter on most often in QA/test automation postings — worth tracking news from the board directly.

mcdc.d: Modified Condition/Decision Coverage — a strict test-coverage criterion requiring every condition in a compound boolean to be shown, on its own, to change the outcome.
mcdc.w: ISO 26262 requires it at higher safety levels — a term worth recognizing instantly in automotive/embedded QA postings.

csms.d: Cyber Security Management System — the certified process UNECE R155 requires carmakers to run across a vehicle's whole life.
csms.w: Regulatory floor under automotive security testing — demand for these skills is written into law, not fashion.

lang_dieversicherung.w: Germany runs on mandatory insurance for almost everything — health, liability, often even contents insurance is expected.

lang_dieanmeldung.d: Residence registration — the mandatory first step after moving to a German address.
lang_dieanmeldung.w: Everything else (bank account, tax ID, health insurance) depends on this being done first.
